title: Virtual ESP32-C3 board: memory-mapped GPIO, timer and UART in the emulator
description:
Feature: Virtual board
  Scenario: Writing the GPIO register lights the LED
    Given a program that stores 1 to the C3 GPIO output register
    When it runs on the virtual board
    Then the LED on the board is lit
right_now_summary: The virtual ESP32-C3 board still needs GPIO, timer, and UART emulation.
